verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a self-hosted TypeScript auth library that stores all auth data in the developer's own database (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.). Users report that they 'own all the data' and are not tied to any provider, which implies the vendor never receives user data that could be used for training. However, the evidence contains no explicit statement or policy about AI training, so this protection is only inferred from the architecture. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training or data-usage policy, documentation of any telemetry or data sent to the vendor (e.g., via the hosted MCP docs server or the CLI), and independent verification that no data leaves the deployment.
